title: 36 Hours in Salt Lake City
abstract: With Utah liquor laws normalized last year, a budding film scene and a fresh crop of indie galleries and boutiques, the city has taken on a more cosmopolitan feel.

title: 36 Hours in Brussels
abstract: For the seat of the European Union, Brussels is a lively capital that exhibits a witty, even wacky sense of humor.

title: 36 Hours in Bordeaux, France
abstract: Thanks to reclaimed docklands and a beautification effort that’s removing centuries of soot, the French city has a new vitality.

title: 36 Hours in St. Louis
abstract: With its green spaces, varied night life and restaurants, plus a mix of Midwestern sensibility and Southern charm, St. Louis is a city looking to the future.
